description: Set an image's clipping path: none, detect edges, an alpha channel or a Photoshop path, with threshold, tolerance, inset and options, or convert the clipping path to a frame (Object > Clipping Path > Options; Convert Clipping Path to Frame)

convertToFrame.description: Afterwards, convert the clipping path to the graphic frame (Object > Clipping Path > Convert Clipping Path to Frame)

pathName.description: The Photoshop path or alpha channel to use (photoshop_path, alpha_channel)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true: graphic frames, or the placed images themselves

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_clipping_path
title: Set Clipping Path
